response.overview: [Complaint Resolution Guide] Disney Cruise Line Complaint Resolution and Escalation Help?  To escalate a complaint with Disney Cruise Line, contact customer +1-866-259-1002 (US) service or guest relations through official channels and request a supervisor or case review. Step-by-Step Escalation Process On Board the Ship: Visit or call the Guest Services desk immediately. For major unresolved service or hotel issues, ask to speak with the Guest Services Manager or Hotel Director. Pre-Cruise or General Support: Call +1-866-259-1002 (US
